name: Loved Ones In Heaven
overview: Scripture assures believers that the death of God’s saints is precious in His sight, marking a divine appointment within the seasons of life and death. Jesus teaches that in the resurrection, earthly institutions like marriage will no longer apply, as the redeemed will be like angels in heaven. This hope is grounded in God’s love demonstrated through Christ, who offers everlasting life to all who believe. Believers are encouraged to trust in Jesus and find comfort in the promise of eternal life with their loved ones in heaven.
